The Best Katie Barfield
Sacrifices of Success by Katie Barfield

Since when is success
measured by happiness, 
by sleep-less nights, 
countless breakdowns,
and stress all the time. 
Its as if we must
give up our lives to live
in this horrid world. 

When we begin this
journey into hell,
The guards are yelling “Stop! 
Leave your passions,
Safe havens, and treasured things
For they will not survive 
The test of time.
They will burn up in the flames
Much like your smile and spirit. “

But you take them anyway, 
Feeling that he must be wrong. 
You can win this redundant war. 
You can find the time for living 
In between what makes you feel dead. 
You push forward thinking
“How bad could it be?”

First, your to-do list grows
Taller and taller and more intimidating. 
It stands before you,
Towering over you,
No choice but to be on your mind. 
You do your best, 
Accomplish each task,
And cross it off your list. 
But its not enough
The list is growing 
Faster than you can keep up. 
You have so much to do
And not enough time. 
And the stress,
Sleep-less nights, 
And anxiety begins. 

After a while,
You feel like you got this under control,
You finally figured it out,
Like you might be able to survive. 
But life throws you a curve ball
And once again,
Your on your knees
Begging for help,
Tears rolling down your face. 
And the headaches,
Breakdowns, 
And depression begins. 

Now, your covered in wounds
From the constant fire,
Your luggage,
You passions far gone. 
Your falling apart 
You can’t take it anymore. 
Its all just too much. 
But how can you escape?
There is no way out,
No exits on this path,
That was decided for you. 
And the negativity 
And thoughts begin. 

Your faced with a new decision 
“Another challenge”
As if you don’t already have it hard enough. 
But what can you say?
Sure, saying yes will just
Add more to your
Overflowing plate,
But “it will be fun”
And they “would love to have you there”
The people in your life 
Are on this path with you,
Even though you feel alone. 
And they think you should do this,
After all, They will be there. 
You want to say yes. 
But instead you must say no
Because your to-do list madd it clear
You never had a choice. 

The most upsetting thing?
This is “success”, 
The only way to have 
A “good life”
In this horrid, horrid world.

The Best Katie Barfield
Art critic: it may just look like a weird brick of legos but you must notice how all of the pieces are different shapes sizes and colors but yet they all fit together to accomplish one thing. It represent diversity itself. Rather than a boring old gray wall where each pieces is identical this wall stands out. It shows that if each person in our society were the same it would be like that boring old gray wall that doesn’t spark creativity. Also all of the pieces, which we may as well establish at this point represent people, are together not torn apart. But that can always change. If you were to pick up this wall and try to break it in one direction it will break in an instant yet if you were to turn the wall 90 degrees and try to break again it wouldn’t because the pieces would be weaved together creating strength. Based on this in depth analysis i have named this piece “diverSity”
